title: Every fruit tastes astringent
odia:
କରମ ଦଶା
ଯେ ଫଳ ଖାଇଲେ ସେ ଫଳ କଷା।
literal_meaning: Such is my lot: whichever fruit I eat is astringent.
meaning_odia: ଦୁର୍ଭାଗ୍ୟ ଏମିତି ଲାଗି ରହିଛି ଯେ ଯାହା ବାଛିଲେ ବି ମନମୁତାବକ ଫଳ ମିଳୁନାହିଁ—ଏହି ହତାଶାର କଥା। ଯେଉଁ ଫଳ ଖାଇଲେ ବି କଷା ଲାଗିବାର ଚିତ୍ରରେ ବାରମ୍ବାର ନିରାଶ ହେବାର ଅନୁଭବ ପ୍ରକାଶ ପାଏ।
explanation: The speaker describes a run of disappointment as bad luck: even choosing a different fruit brings the same unwelcome taste. This editorial reading treats the line as an expression of frustration when nothing seems to turn out well.
usage_example: After several carefully chosen plans fall through, someone sighs that every choice seems to bring another disappointment and recalls this saying. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: Fruit offers the prospect of an enjoyable taste, but every fruit here turns out astringent. The repeated ଯେ ଫଳ … ସେ ଫଳ makes disappointment seem to follow every choice, while କରମ ଦଶା names the speaker’s sense of an unfortunate lot.

graphic.alt: A downcast adult holds a bitten fruit beside a basket of other partly eaten fruits.
graphic.caption: An imagined taster finds disappointment in one choice after another.

odia_summary: ଯାହା ବାଛିଲେ ବି ନିରାଶା ମିଳିବାକୁ ନିଜ ଦୁର୍ଭାଗ୍ୟ ବୋଲି ମଣିବା।
english_summary: A run of disappointments feels like bad luck following every choice.
